cases.prompt: Set up BoxLite. Offer Cloud OAuth, Cloud API key, and Local, and use my selected mode.
cases.expected: Exactly three choices with capabilities explained; verify chosen host connection or local runtime; preserve choice; no credentials in chat or package.
cases.tools: Host OAuth/MCP setup or native private API-key configuration; guarded local launcher for Local.

cases.prompt: Create a small temporary Python Box, print hello, and retain its ID for the next steps. In Local, choose an available host port and publish it to guest port 8000 when creating the Box for P4; explain that publication binds all host interfaces.
cases.expected: Create succeeds; execution completes with stdout hello and exit code 0; report the returned Box ID. For Local, also record the host-to-guest port mapping for P4.
cases.tools: Cloud createBox and startExecution; Local create with -p HOST_PORT:8000, then start/exec; choose HOST_PORT before creation.

cases.prompt: Upload harmless text and binary files into a directory in that Box, then download them to a new local directory.
cases.expected: Both operations complete, both downloaded files match the original bytes and expected placement, and model output contains no archive base64. Compare the files from this download without adding a checksum, upload readback, or credential fallback.
cases.tools: Cloud packaged transfer.py calling existing uploadFiles/downloadFiles via the explicitly selected Codex or Claude client; Local cp and local byte comparison.

cases.prompt: Start a small HTTP app in that Box, update its response, and preserve a separate persistent marker and the same Box ID. In Local, bind the guest app to 0.0.0.0:8000 and reuse P2's recorded host port without recreating the Box.
cases.expected: Guest app serves both versions, persistent marker survives, Box ID is unchanged; verify actual public URL only in API-key mode with permission, or http://127.0.0.1:HOST_PORT in Local using P2's mapping; OAuth reports its tunnel restriction.
cases.tools: Cloud startExecution, getExecution, uploadFiles through transfer.py, getBox; discover prepareTunnel only when permitted. Local exec/cp and the port mapping configured during P2.

cases.prompt: Stop and remove only the temporary Box created for these cases, then verify it is gone.
cases.expected: Only recorded ID is stopped and removed; subsequent lookup confirms not-found; unrelated resources remain untouched.
cases.tools: Cloud stopBox, getBox, removeBox; Local stop/rm/list.

cases.prompt: Select Cloud API key with the configured key missing or empty, even if OAuth was used earlier.
cases.expected: Stop before any workload operation; no cached OAuth or other credential fallback; offer to repair the selected configuration without requesting secret values in chat.
cases.tools: No workload tools; native configuration check only.

cases.prompt: In the verified temporary Box, execute a command that exits with code 7.
cases.expected: Report exit code 7 as failure despite successful transport; do not claim success or retry the write automatically.

cases.prompt: Using Cloud OAuth, create a new public tunnel for the test app.
cases.expected: Explain the scope restriction or report the actual authorization denial; no tunnel success claim, API-key switch, CLI fallback, or invented public URL.
cases.tools: Read live schema/policy; any attempted operation stays on the selected OAuth connection.
